videoDetails.title: 2026云栖大会：阿里CEO吴泳铭主旨演讲 | 2026 Yunqi Conference: Keynote Speech by Alibaba CEO Wu Yongming
videoDetails.shortDescription:
2026云栖大会在杭州开幕，阿里CEO吴泳铭发表了主旨演讲，核心观点是：‌我们正进入“机器智能”时代，未来机器思考总量将达到人类的1000倍以上，而阿里将坚定投入AI模型、AI芯片、AI云三大基石‌。‌‌
吴泳铭把AI模型、AI芯片、AI云比作机器智能时代的“发电站和电网”，并公布了具体目标：
1、AI模型‌：Qwen团队在递归式自我改进（RSI）上取得进展，计划训练‌5-10T参数‌规模的全新模型，向超级智能（ASI）迈进；同时推进多模态模型研发。‌‌
‌2、AI芯片‌：平头哥发布新一代国产AI芯片‌真武V900‌，算力达前代M890的3倍，单一集群可扩展至‌50万卡‌。芯片产品线已覆盖GPU（真武）、CPU（倚天）、智能网卡（磐脉）和互联芯片。‌‌
‌3、AI云‌：目标到2032年，阿里云全球数据中心规模‌超过20GW‌，打造承载“机器智能”的超级电网。‌‌
The 2026 Yunqi Conference opened in Hangzhou, where Alibaba CEO Wu Yongming delivered a keynote speech. His key message was: we are entering the era of ‘machine intelligence’; in the future, the total computing power of machines will exceed that of humans by more than 1,000 times, and Alibaba will remain firmly committed to its three cornerstones: AI models, AI chips and AI cloud.
Wu Yongming likened AI models, AI chips and AI cloud to the “power stations and power grids” of the machine intelligence era, and announced specific targets:
1. AI models: The Qwen team has made progress in Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) and plans to train a brand-new model with 5–10 T of parameters, moving towards Artificial Superintelligence (ASI); simultaneously, it is advancing the research and development of multimodal models.‌‌
‌2. AI chips‌: PingTouGe has launched the new-generation domestically produced AI chip, Zhenwu V900, which delivers three times the computing power of its predecessor, the M890, and can scale up to 500,000 cards in a single cluster. The chip product line now covers GPUs (Zhenwu), CPUs (Yitian), intelligent network cards (Panmai) and interconnect chips.‌‌
‌3. AI Cloud‌: The target is for Alibaba Cloud’s global data centre capacity to exceed 20 GW by 2032, creating a super grid capable of supporting ‘machine intelligence’.‌‌
